description: Save a search (the query and filters of pitchspark_search_pitches_v2) under the caller's API key, to list and re-run later with pitchspark_list_saved_searches_v1. Use when: the investor asks to save or remember a search. Do not use for: alerts (not delivered yet: saving does not send anything), running the search (pitchspark_search_pitches_v2). Requires a PitchSpark API key with the searches:write scope (keys without a scope list hold it). Idempotent: the same normalised query and filters under the same key returns the existing saved search (status "already_saved") and writes nothing new. At most 20 saved searches per key (status "limit_reached"); 50 saves per key per UTC day (RATE_LIMITED). Do not put personal data (names, emails, phone numbers, anything about a person) in "name" or "query": they are stored for up to 180 days. Emails and phone numbers that do appear are stored as [redacted]. Saved searches are deleted 180 days after they were last saved, and with the account. Returns {"status","saved_search","max_per_key","next_steps"}.

created_within_days.description: Recency: listed on PitchSpark within this many days.

green_flags.description: Traction signal: at least one of these founder-chosen green flags (e.g. "Profitable", "Signed LOI").

has_traction.description: Traction signal: true = only pitches with a public traction note.

location.description: HQ region key or list: us, canada, latam, uk, europe, mea, apac, global_remote.

max_raise_usd.description: Raise at most this many US dollars (disclosed asks only).

min_raise_usd.description: Raise at least this many US dollars (disclosed asks only).

min_score.description: Public PitchSpark score at least this (values under 70 are read as 70; pitches without a public score are left out).

name.description: A short label, e.g. "Seed fintech in Europe".

query.description: Optional plain-English request, 1 to 200 characters, read by the same rules as pitchspark_search_pitches_v1 (sector, stage, place, raise, score and traction cues; quotes and "not X"). Keyword + synonym matching, not semantic search.

sector.description: Sector key or list of up to 10 (primary or additional sector). Keys: fintech, healthtech, saas, marketplace, ai_ml, consumer, enterprise, climate, edtech, crypto, biotech, hardware, gaming, real_estate, food_beverage, fashion, travel, sports, media, femtech, cybersecurity, dev_tools, ecommerce, logistics, mobility, hr_tech, legal_tech, insurtech, proptech, agtech, energy, robotics, govtech, hospitality, other.

sort.description: relevance (keyword + synonym score; "top scoring" in the query still orders by score), score (public score, pitches without one last), recency (newest listing first), most_viewed_by_investors (Pitch.views_count, all viewers), recently_updated.

stage.description: Funding stage or list. "early" means pre_seed, seed and series_a.

updated_within_days.description: Recency: pitch updated within this many days.

name: pitchspark_save_search_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Save a startup search (query and filters) to re-run later
